---
name: Bug report
about: Report incorrect analysis, unsafe behavior, or a broken integration
title: "bug: "
labels: bug
---

## Reproduction

Describe the repository shape, command, and smallest fixture that reproduces the issue.

## Expected and actual behavior

Explain the expected evidence and what PatchSignal reported instead.

## Environment

Include PatchSignal version, Python version, operating system, and output format. Remove secrets and private source code.

## Security

If the issue could execute code, access the network unexpectedly, escape the output path, or expose source content, do not publish details here; follow `SECURITY.md` instead.
